A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
ejaculation delay is related to a high peak plasma concentration of SSRIs, and that the duration of this high peak plasma concentration is related to the half life of the SSRI.
the ejaculation delay of the SSRI is a pharmacokinetic rather than a pharmacodynamic phenomenon.
